title: Adventure reference companion: Quests, Scenario Journal and Puzzle Map
summary: Complete native journal browsing/reading/tab/location/Close journeys and a one-shot final covered Puzzle Map image on the lower display. Native models, visibility, callbacks and save rules remain authoritative.
preparation: Back up app data and Saves-upstream. Verify exact candidate receipt, APK SHA-256 and package is.xyz.vcmi.thor; install in place without uninstalling. Prepare disposable maps/saves with more than five quests/events, varied native components, long/Unicode text and zero/partial/full obelisk discovery; test multiple faction puzzle artworks. Record unavailable scenarios explicitly.
limitations: Native journal windows are authoritative snapshots; reopen them to receive newly collected entries just as above. Transport bounds: 10000 entries, five rows, 8192 UTF-8 bytes of complete selected native text, 384 bytes per transport page and readable Android subpages. Unsupported text/list data uses the native upper window. Puzzle capture is one software snapshot after reveal, fixed 592x544 RGB with remaining native covers; it is not a continuous frame stream. No grail coordinates or unmasked image cross JNI. Hardware must verify masking, scaling, readability and focus.

checks.title: Quest browsing and complete native information
checks.steps: Prepare more than five quests, differing requirements/states and long/Unicode text. Open Quests below, page in both directions, select first/middle/last entries, choose Read and page through all text/subpages. Compare native list, description and component popup information above. Change selection above while reading below.
checks.expected: Native order and current selection agree. Every bounded entry and full published native description/component information is readable, including Unicode. No invented rewards/completion or hidden quest data; upper selection invalidates stale text/actions.

checks.title: Scenario Journal and native tab navigation
checks.steps: Prepare more than five scenario events, including multiline text and component rewards. Switch Quests/Events below and above; page/select/read every entry. Test unavailable tabs, no quest/no event cases and an empty journal where reachable.
checks.expected: The normal native close-and-open tab route is used. Correct day/message/component information appears. Disabled native tabs stay disabled; empty/unsupported states are explicit. Selection, text pages and hit regions never leak between owners.

checks.title: Native location actions and Close
checks.steps: Select quests with a surviving native source and events with and without a valid location. Use Locate below and compare native map-marker centering. Close each journal using either screen; reopen from Adventure.
checks.expected: Locate follows the existing native marker callback and is disabled without a valid native target. No coordinates cross JNI. Close restores the actual native parent with correct selection/input and no residual window.

checks.title: Covered Puzzle Map and progress
checks.steps: Use disposable games at zero, partial and complete obelisk discovery. Open Puzzle Map below; compare every revealed region and remaining cover with the native window after its reveal animation. Check progress, different factions/puzzle art, UI scaling/resolution and Close.
checks.expected: One final bounded masked image appears after reveal. Every native hidden region stays covered: no unmasked preview, grail coordinates or premature image. Progress matches native discovery. Image aspect ratio and readability remain correct, native upper rendering stays intact and Close restores Adventure. Missing/blank or incorrectly masked images fail this check.

checks.title: Stale targets, multitouch and modal restoration
checks.steps: Hold a row, page, Locate, tab or Close while changing native selection/window above. Rapidly repeat actions; drag outside, add/remove a second pointer and hold too long. Cover each owner with a modal, then dismiss from either screen.
checks.expected: Only the exact live owner/parent/revision and current target executes, at most once. Old releases and duplicate taps cannot navigate/center/close a replacement window. Normal modal cleanup restores the real parent; no stuck pending controls.

checks.title: Display lifecycle and neighboring journeys
checks.steps: While reading and inspecting Puzzle Map, toggle the lower panel, background/resume and detach/reconnect/recreate the display. Recheck Save/name editor/Load, Settings/shared confirmations, spellbook, Adventure/Hero/Town and Battle/result restoration. Check upper touch/controller, hotseat player switch and single-display behavior.
checks.expected: Exactly one fresh non-focusable panel returns with current player/context data. No stale image/text, leaked gesture, focus theft, repeated snapshot loop or upper-screen regression. Existing native game, quest, visibility and save behavior stays unchanged.
